name: CMOSS
fullName: Extracranial-Intracranial Bypass and Risk of Stroke and Death in Patients With Symptomatic Artery Occlusion
population: n=324, median 52.7; 79.3% men, NIHSS TIA or non-disabling ischemic stroke attributed to hemodynamic insufficiency, 2 years
teachingPoint: EC-IC bypass for symptomatic ICA/MCA occlusion with hemodynamic insufficiency showed no benefit over medical therapy at 2 years.
